200.description:
Text search for upcoming events SpotHero sells parking for (api.spothero.com/v2/events/search, the search box's 'Upcoming Events' suggestions): event id, title, start/end (local with offset), parking window, destination id/title/coordinates/time zone. Upstream matches the query's words against event titles and performer names, not against venues: 'SoFi Stadium' returns SOFI TUKKER concerts and other stadiums' events, none at SoFi Stadium. For a venue, resolve it with search_destinations and list its events with destination_events; when filtering these results by venue, compare `destination_id` with the resolved one. No match returns an empty list.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `events` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `city` | string |  |
| `destination_id` | string |  |
| `destination_title` | string |  |
| `ends` | string |  |
| `event_id` | string |  |
| `latitude` | number |  |
| `longitude` | number |  |
| `parking_window` | object |  |
| `search_url` | string | spothero.com search page for this event's parking. |
| `seo_url` | string |  |
| `starts` | string |  |
| `time_zone` | string |  |
| `title` | string |  |

200.description:

Each result carries the facility record and monthly quotes: `total_price` for the first month (service fee included), `advertised_price` (the monthly rate), contract terms, activation fee, in/out privileges, start-date choices and access hours. Pages via `cursor`/`next_cursor`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from a previous page of this function. When given, the other search inputs must be omitted.

destination_id.description:

ends.description: Local wall-clock time at the parking location, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` or `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss`, no offset (SpotHero interprets it in the facility's time zone). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2})?$.

oversize.description: Search for an oversize vehicle (default false).

page_size.description:

show_unavailable.description: Include facilities that cannot be booked for the window, with their `unavailable_reasons` (default false).

starts.description: Local wall-clock time at the parking location, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` or `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss`, no offset (SpotHero interprets it in the facility's time zone). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2})?$.

200.description:
Search hourly/daily (transient) parking around a coordinate for an arrival/departure window (api.spothero.com/v2/search/transient, the request behind spothero.com/search). Each result is a facility with its address, distance from the origin, rating, live availability, access hours, restrictions, vehicle limits and one or more priced quotes for the window: `total_price` (what SpotHero charges, service fee included) and `advertised_price` (the headline rate without the fee), itemised. Event rates can widen the priced window; read each quote's `starts`/`ends`. Pass a SpotHero `destination_id` to anchor the search on a venue (its coordinates from `destination`) and to get `spot_url` links. Pages via `cursor`/`next_cursor`. Prices are USD in the US and CAD in Canada, taxes not itemised.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.
